Nova Marketing Agent

Nova Marketing Agent is a tool operated by Nova Build for authorized staff to research remodeling advertising keywords and review performance of the company’s Google Ads accounts. The current integration performs read-only account and campaign checks. Keyword research is planned after Google grants the required API access. It does not currently publish ads, change budgets, or make payments.

Research and reporting

The tool supports Nova Build’s preparation for kitchen and bathroom remodeling advertising across Seattle’s Eastside. Access requires authorization from the Google Ads account owner.

Google account connection

Google’s OAuth permission includes viewing and managing Google Ads data. Our current local QA workflow uses read-only requests. This informational page does not ask you to sign in or enter credentials.

Operated by Nova Build. Questions: 941novabuild@gmail.com.
